verdict.rationale: Kling publishes a per-generation dollar price table by mode, duration and audio option (e.g. $0.35 for a 5s pro image-to-video, $0.126/s standard motion control), so a marketer can work out costs in advance, and it states that failed generations don't consume credits. There is no evidence of an in-product cost estimate shown before each run, or of any usage or spend-tracking view; centralized team billing is related but is not a spend tracker. Missing for 10: in-app pre-generation credit or cost estimate, post-run usage/spend history or dashboard, independent corroboration.
